37.constraint: Use this warm-brown controlled tapered-straight trouser once only for Fall/Spring Office, Interview, Date Night, smart Casual Everyday or city Travel. Pair with a regular-fit cream, white, pale-blue, sage, soft-pink, burgundy or dark-green top and low-profile off-white, tobacco, dark-brown or oxblood footwear; never use an oversized top, bulky trainer, all-dark brown palette, Sports/Workout, beach Resort, formal black-tie styling, or any Wedding/Wedding Guest use.

rejectionGroups.reason: These identities fail the hard image-proof gate because five recorded supplier images are broken and their full front/back product details cannot be verified.
These tops are graphic, slogan, pseudo-brand, tactical, sport-jersey, costume or novelty-led, often dark and oversized, and cannot support a clean versatile Zara-led wardrobe.
The color-block T-shirt has a long generic cut, a visible pseudo-brand chest mark and a mostly-polyester construction, so it does not meet the modern premium gate.
These product-only wide jeans and trousers lack reliable on-body proof through the rise, thigh and shoe break; several also use dated plaid or contrast washes.
The black relaxed trouser remains too wide and dark-repetitive, while the paint-splatter jean is novelty-led and puddled.
These dress and casual trousers are visibly skinny, ankle-cropped, thigh-clinging, artificial-looking or repetitive in black/navy and fail the balanced regular-fit gate.
The elastic-waist stretch pant reads as a generic synthetic athletic trouser rather than a polished Zara-led casual or office garment.
The ripped black straight jean is heavily distressed, stacked and visually dated.
